description: 手机 QQ / 微信 ↔ 天枢直连桥：原生会话、命令层、交互转发

tools.name: im_status
tools.description: Report tianshu-imbridge status: phase, mode (serve-native/headless), enabled channels (QQ / WeChat), session map, inbound/reply stats

tools.name: im_send
tools.description: Send a proactive message to the owner (notification) over QQ or WeChat. Defaults to the configured owner / last inbound sender of the chosen channel.

tools.name: weixin_bind_start
tools.description: Start WeChat (iLink/ClawBot) binding: generates a QR code image onto the user's Desktop and waits in the background for the scan.

tools.name: weixin_bind_status
tools.description: Check the WeChat binding progress: whether the QR was scanned, whether credentials were saved, and what to do next.
